description.value: Gyu King Teppanyaki is a Japanese teppanyaki restaurant located on Burrard Street in downtown Vancouver. The restaurant specializes in teppanyaki-style cooking — meats, seafood, and vegetables prepared on large tabletop iron grills. Its central downtown location makes it a convenient dining stop for cyclists moving through the core of the city.
